subject: Post-demo: DPA module preference + vendor security questionnaire
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Clara Jensen <clara.jensen@medasyshealth.com>
Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 May 2027 15:08:00 +0000
Subject: Post-demo: DPA module preference + vendor security questionnaire

Hi Clara —

Thanks again for taking the demo with the MedaSys team earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the compliance items we discussed: 

- DPA / SCC: We understand you need a DPA and the EU SCCs for your procurement review. Our typical pattern is Redwood acts as a processor; customers are controllers. For SCC module choice, most healthcare customers select the controller->processor flow (EU SCCs – Module 2). Please confirm if your legal prefers a different mapping.

- SOC 2: You asked about scope — Redwood’s SOC 2 Type II covers the hosted inference control plane and our production serving runtime (controls list attached as a one-pager). It does not cover customer-managed private deployments; we can call that out explicitly if you need.

- Vendor security questionnaire: I’ve attached a short SOC2 summary and a blank vendor SQ template so your security team can mark the must-haves. If you want, we can pre-fill the sections we control and return a partially completed copy.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm whether MedaSys wants Redwood designated as processor under the DPA (recommended) — reply to this thread.
2) I will return a partially completed vendor security questionnaire + SOC2 summary by EOD Thursday (attached stub).
3) If helpful, schedule a 30-min follow-up with our Security/Legal to close open items; here’s my calendar: https://cal.com/logan/redwood-compliance (or suggest times).

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (1pg summary), security_questionnaire_MEDASYS_v1.pdf (blank template)

Thanks — look forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Logan Wright
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Hi Logan —

Appreciate the recap. A few clarifying questions from our side: 

1) Controller/processor: Legal at MedaSys leans toward naming us as controller and Redwood as processor, which matches what you suggested. Please state that clearly in the DPA language you typically use so our counsel can see it.
2) SOC 2 scope: Can you confirm the period covered (start/end dates) and whether encryption-at-rest and key management details are in the report? Our security team will want to validate that.
3) Vendor SQ: We’ll send the full questionnaire back to security@medasyshealth.com. If you can pre-fill the items you control that would speed review.

Propose we aim to close the DPA/SCC decision this week so procurement can start redlining.

Thanks,

1) We’ll share the partially completed vendor SQ (attached) — please route the full questionnaire back to security@medasyshealth.com.
2) Legal: review the attached DPA paragraph and SCC Module 2 mapping — if OK, we’ll open a DocuSign DPA so procurement can redline.
3) If your security team wants a live 30-min call to walk the vendor questionnaire, Karthik and our Security lead are available Friday afternoon (2–4pm CET).

If that plan looks good I’ll kick off the DocuSign and book the call.

Best,
